meta.note: A list for people and for a later config-driven setup. No game file reads these files today. Nothing here changes what the game does.
meta.types_note: "text" (a typed name) and "record" (an object with several values) were added to the five types of the request, because the game stores both.
meta.storage_note: c.* is one profile (G.chars[n]). c.x.* is the container of the answers of each feature. G.* is the whole game on the device and in the account. "database:" is kept by the account, not in the saved game.
meta.certainty_note: supports: true (Guess / Close / Exact are kept with the value), "derived" (worked out from its rows), "partial" (a guess or a real answer only), false (a choice with no such state), "cant_tell".
meta.evidence_note: evidence is a text scan of game/ (not the four big data files): reads and direct writes of the key. Many answers are written by one shared action (set, tog, kitset) that the scan does not count as a write, so a low write count is not proof of an orphan.
meta.confidence_note: confidence "low" marks an entry whose name or meaning was not checked by reading the code that uses it.
